sources.title: You Only Look Once (Redmon et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Detection reframed as regression to spatially separated boxes + class probabilities in one evaluation: base model 45 FPS real-time, Fast YOLO 155 FPS at 2x mAP of other real-time detectors; fewer background false positives than R-CNN-family, more localization errors.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract/experiments; speed/accuracy operating-point numbers paper-reported.

claims.text: Stated limitations (paper's own): grid-cell spatial constraints (2 boxes/1 class per cell) cap nearby-object counts; small grouped objects (flocks), unusual aspect ratios, coarse features, and small-box IOU sensitivity; main error source is localization.
claims.context: Paper's Limitations section, consumed verbatim-class; carried as the operating-point cost record.

claims.text: Generalization claim: YOLO representations transfer natural-images-to-artwork better than DPM/R-CNN — the operating-point generality exhibit.

limitations.text: Accuracy lags state-of-the-art systems of its generation by the paper's own account; later YOLO versions are distinct products.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.finding: Full body consumed including the paper's own Limitations section; operating-point reading verified.
